hard_rules.fair_housing: Never describe who a home or neighborhood is FOR. No 'perfect for families', no 'safe', no school-quality claims. Amenities and distances only.
hard_rules.attribution: Every generated asset carries the disclosure_line.
hard_rules.property_claims: No price, sqft, status, or days-on-market unless supplied by the user. Never web-searched.
hard_rules.client_privacy: No client messages, names, or transaction detail without written permission.
hard_rules.no_ai_likeness: Never generate, suggest, or script a synthetic version of her face or voice. No AI avatars, no voice cloning. Her likeness is her own.

voice.emoji: Sparingly, and warmly. She uses 👋🏾 in a greeting. One per post at most, never as bullets or decoration. The earlier 'basically never' reading was stricter than she actually writes.

hashtags.why_fewer: Mosseri confirmed in a July 2026 Q&A that hashtags do not affect reach, and Instagram removed hashtag following in December 2024. They are a categorisation signal that tells the algorithm what a post is about, not a distribution lever. A wall of tags adds noise without adding reach.
hashtags.rule: At least two hyperlocal to the exact place in the post. Never mega-tags — #realestate, #realtor, #dreamhome sit on 50M+ posts and return bot follows.
what_matters_more: The PROFILE NAME field — Instagram indexes it in search, and it is not the @handle. 'Jeyashree Haridoss | Raleigh + Cary Realtor' is worth more than any tag she will ever use.
Searchable keywords in the caption itself. Instagram has real keyword search now, so the words 'Cary realtor' written plainly beat #caryrealtor.
Saves, shares and watch time. These are the actual distribution signals.

voice.tone: Short complete sentences, one idea each. Specific over vague. No hype words.

pillars.reach: Walkable and bikeable Triangle life — neighborhoods, greenways, parks. The differentiator.
pillars.convert: Sellers and buyers ready to move. Luxury positioning lives here.

never_talk_down_an_area.rule: Every place she serves gets its pros highlighted. Never position one town as the consolation prize for another, and never imply people 'escaped' somewhere. She wants clients in all six markets.
never_talk_down_an_area.applies_to: Comparisons, migration stories, price framing, and 'why people leave X' angles.
never_talk_down_an_area.instead: Frame movement as a different stage or a different fit, never a downgrade or a forced exit. Two places can both be excellent for different reasons — say that.
banned_framings: can't afford X so settle for Y
better value than X (as a knock on X)
never_talk_down_an_area.also_why: Comparative put-downs of whole areas edge toward steering. Framing each place on its own merits is both better business and safer under Fair Housing.

register.learned_from: Her own first-post caption, written 2026-08-29 — the first real voice sample.
rules: Open with warmth, not with a claim. She greets; do not lead with a credential.
Casual and current: 'the gram', contractions, an exclamation mark is fine.
Lifestyle sits beside infrastructure. Coffee and greenways in the same breath — do not write her as purely analytical.
Generous CTAs. 'I'll share my favorites' beats 'DM me to get started'.
Self-aware rather than authoritative. She will name an awkward truth and make it disarming instead of hiding it.
register.my_bias_to_correct: Drafts written for her have run more formal, more infrastructural and more transactional than she is. Warm her up before showing her anything.

deep_local_knowledge: Cary and Morrisville — grew up in both, can speak first-hand to how they changed
The Highway 55 corridor — her parents moved West Cary to Fuquay-Varina/Holly Springs, the same move many families she grew up with made
service_area.avoid_reason: Not her expertise, so she does not position herself as a guide there. She is still happy to help clients in these areas — this is about not claiming authority, not about declining business.
service_area.cary_note: High quality and high cost, and highly coveted — especially West Cary. She actively wants Cary clients. Cary is never the 'before' in a before-and-after story.

story_assets.the_55_corridor: Grew up in Cary and Morrisville. Her parents moved from West Cary out to Fuquay-Varina/Holly Springs along Highway 55 — the same migration many families she grew up with made. Lets her speak to the growth as someone who watched it happen, not someone who read about it.
story_assets.downtown_raleigh: Lives there now. First-hand on walkability, greenway access, and daily life.
story_assets.use: Lead reach content with these. They are the thing no competitor can copy. Never invent story detail — if a specific is not confirmed, ask her.
